07436 Ramathayim Tsowphiym {raw-maw-thah'-yim tso-feem'}

源於 07413 的雙數型 和 06822 的主動分詞的複數型; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Ramathaimzophim 1; 1

拉瑪瑣非 = "瞭望塔的兩倍高"
1) 撒母耳的家鄉, 位在以法蓮的山區 （#撒上 1:1|）
   1a) 與 07414 同
record.edic_text:
07436 Ramathayim Tsowphiym {raw-maw-thah'-yim tso-feem'}

from the dual of 07413 and the plural of the act part of 06822; n pr loc

AV - Ramathaimzophim 1; 1

Ramathaim-zophim = "double height of the watchers"
1) the home place of Samuel located in the hill country of Ephraim
   1a) the same as 07414
